blurb: Guests rent boats including Berkshire tritoons, Sea-Doo jet skis, and 50-person party barges with captains. Party barges come equipped with water slides, grills, coolers, sound systems, chairs, tables, and a captain who can cook your food. The marina also offers covered boat slips, a fuel dock, and a ship store with supplies and local beers.
extraNote: 10% military discount any day · 10% weekday discount Monday to Thursday · Discounts for extended reservations: $5 off per hour for 5-7 hours, $10 off per hour for 8-10 hours · Party barge prices include gas, tax, crew, safety equipment · Deposit required for party barge reservations · VIP Lake Travis Marina docks at 16107-B FM 2769, Leander, TX 78641 · Peak season March 1 to September 30; Non-peak October 1 to February 28
